SELECT p.id, p.code, p.name, p.parent_code, p.ancestor_codes, p.is_maintained, p.belong_network_code, p.update_time, p.credit_level, p.lon, p.lat, p.another_name, p.boundary_points, p.center_point, p.addr_level, p.type, p.etl_dt, p.type_code, p.rural_grid_type, p.user_id, u1.nick_name userName, p.user_manager_num, p.second_user_id, p.second_user_name, p.second_manager_num, coalesce(gmi.duty_network_name, t.customer_name) AS anchorName, coalesce(a.id, assigned_anchor.id) as anchorId FROM pa_addr_info_type p left join performance_customer_info t on p.user_id=t.id left join `kx-admin-renhang`.anchor_point a on t.customer_nm = a.customer_nm left join grid_message_info gmi on gmi.grid_code = p.code left join anchor_point assigned_anchor on assigned_anchor.anchor_name = gmi.duty_network_name left join sys_user u1 on u1.user_id = p.user_id
and p.type_code = #{typeCode}
and p.ancestor_codes like concat('%,',#{code},',%')
and p.user_id = #{userId}
and p.dept_id = #{deptId}
and p.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and u1.nick_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
and coalesce(gmi.duty_network_name, t.customer_name) like concat('%', #{anchorName}, '%')
and coalesce(gmi.duty_network_name, t.customer_name) is not null
and coalesce(gmi.duty_network_name, t.customer_name) is null
and addr_level=5
ORDER BY addr_level,code

SELECT pait.`code` AS gridCode, pait.`name` AS gridName, -- g.grid_branch_charge_id AS grid_branch_charge_id, g.grid_branch_charge_code AS grid_branch_charge_code, g.grid_branch_charge_name AS grid_branch_charge_name, -- g.org_id AS org_id, g.org_code AS org_code, g.org_name AS org_name FROM pa_addr_info_type pait INNER JOIN ( SELECT gi.grid_code AS grid_code, dp.grid_branch_charge_id AS grid_branch_charge_id, dp.grid_branch_charge_code AS grid_branch_charge_code, dp.grid_branch_charge_name AS grid_branch_charge_name, dp.org_id AS org_id, dp.org_code AS org_code, dp.org_name AS org_name FROM grid_info gi INNER JOIN ( SELECT d.dept_id AS grid_branch_charge_id, d.org_num AS grid_branch_charge_code, d.dept_name AS grid_branch_charge_name, f.dept_id AS org_id, f.org_num AS org_code, f.dept_name AS org_name FROM sys_dept d JOIN ( SELECT dept_id FROM sys_dept WHERE org_num = #{orgNum} LIMIT 1 ) root ON FIND_IN_SET( root.dept_id, d.ancestors ) LEFT JOIN sys_dept f ON FIND_IN_SET( f.dept_id, d.ancestors ) AND f.dot_type = '2' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_dept f2 WHERE f2.dot_type = '2' AND FIND_IN_SET( f2.dept_id, d.ancestors ) AND CHAR_LENGTH( f2.ancestors ) > CHAR_LENGTH( f.ancestors ) ) WHERE d.dot_type = '3'
AND d.dept_name LIKE concat('%',#{branchName},'%')
) dp ON gi.grid_branch_charge = dp.grid_branch_charge_code ) g ON g.grid_code = pait.`code` WHERE pait.addr_level = 5
AND pait.ancestor_codes like concat('%,',#{gridCode},',%')
AND pait.name like concat('%,',#{gridName},',%')

select pait.code as grid_code, pait.name as grid_name, pait.ancestor_codes as grid_ancestor_codes, gi.grid_branch_charge as branch_code, sd.dept_name as branch_name, sd.ancestors as branch_ancestors, sd.dot_type as type, sd.dept_classify as dept_classify, sd.org_id as org_dept_id, sd.org_code as org_dept_code, sd.org_name as org_dept_name from pa_addr_info_type pait left join grid_info gi on pait.code = gi.grid_code left join (SELECT d.dept_id AS dept_id, d.org_num AS org_num, d.dept_name AS dept_name, d.ancestors AS ancestors, d.dot_type AS dot_type, d.dept_classify AS dept_classify, f.dept_id AS org_id, f.org_num AS org_code, f.dept_name AS org_name FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN sys_dept f ON FIND_IN_SET(f.dept_id, d.ancestors) AND f.dot_type = '2' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_dept f2 WHERE f2.dot_type = '2' AND FIND_IN_SET(f2.dept_id, d.ancestors) AND CHAR_LENGTH(f2.ancestors) > CHAR_LENGTH(f.ancestors))) sd on gi.grid_branch_charge = sd.org_num where pait.addr_level = 5

select pait.code as grid_code, pait.name as grid_name, pait.ancestor_codes as grid_ancestor_codes, gi.grid_branch_charge as branch_code, sd.dept_name as branch_name, sd.ancestors as branch_ancestors, sd.dot_type as type, sd.dept_classify as dept_classify, sd.org_id as org_dept_id, sd.org_code as org_dept_code, sd.org_name as org_dept_name, sd.org_area_code as org_dept_area_code, sd.org_area_ancestor_codes AS org_dept_area_ancestor_codes from pa_addr_info_type pait left join grid_info gi on pait.code = gi.grid_code left join (SELECT d.dept_id AS dept_id, d.org_num AS org_num, d.dept_name AS dept_name, d.ancestors AS ancestors, d.dot_type AS dot_type, d.dept_classify AS dept_classify, f.dept_id AS org_id, f.org_num AS org_code, f.dept_name AS org_name, f.area_code AS org_area_code, pait2.ancestor_codes AS org_area_ancestor_codes FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN sys_dept f ON FIND_IN_SET(f.dept_id, d.ancestors) AND f.dot_type = '2' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_dept f2 WHERE f2.dot_type = '2' AND FIND_IN_SET(f2.dept_id, d.ancestors) AND CHAR_LENGTH(f2.ancestors) > CHAR_LENGTH(f.ancestors)) left join pa_addr_info_type pait2 on f.area_code = pait2.code ) sd on gi.grid_branch_charge = sd.org_num where pait.code = #{gridCode}
